verdict.rationale: Consensus's own docs say a REST API and MCP server expose the same retrieval and synthesis surface that powers the web app, and a filter such as excludePreprints is documented on both surfaces. That parity claim covers retrieval and synthesis only. Nothing shows UI features like the Library (Zotero/BibTeX import), Citation Graph, Threads, Deep Search or the Consensus Meter are reachable via the API. Missing for 10: API coverage of library management and import, Citation Graph, Threads and Deep Search; a full API reference showing endpoint parity; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
